title: Desktop, Laptop & Printer Support Engineer
description:
Desktop, Laptop \& Printer Support Engineer

Department: IT / Technical Support

Location: \[Insert Location]

Experience Required: \[Insert years, e.g. 2–4 years]

Employment Type: \[Full\-time / Contract]

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Hardware Support Engineer to provide end\-to\-end technical support for

desktops, laptops, and printers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for installation,

troubleshooting, repair, and preventive maintenance of end\-user hardware, ensuring minimal

downtime and smooth day\-to\-day IT operations.

Key Responsibilities

Desktop \& Laptop Support

\* Install, configure, and set up new desktops and laptops, including OS installation and driver

updates

\* Diagnose and repair hardware faults — motherboard, RAM, HDD/SSD, power supply,

display, keyboard, battery, and cooling issues

\* Upgrade hardware components (RAM, storage, SSD migration) as per requirement

\* Perform data backup and restoration during hardware replacement or repair

\* Troubleshoot boot failures, blue screen errors, overheating, and performance issues

\* Install and configure antivirus, drivers, and standard business applications

\* Set up and troubleshoot peripherals — monitors, keyboards, mice, docking stations,

webcams

\* Conduct periodic preventive maintenance (cleaning, thermal paste replacement, health

checks)

Printer Support

\* Install, configure, and set up network and local printers (laser, inkjet, multifunction)

\* Troubleshoot printer issues — paper jams, print quality, connectivity, driver errors

\* Perform printer maintenance — toner/cartridge replacement, drum unit and fuser

servicing, cleaning

\* Configure shared/network printers, print servers, and printer IP settings

\* Coordinate with vendors for printer repairs, part replacement, and AMC\-covered services

\* Maintain printer usage logs, consumable stock, and service history

General Support \& Documentation

\* Log, track, and resolve support tickets within defined SLA timelines

\* Maintain accurate records of hardware inventory, warranty status, and service history

\* Coordinate with OEM/vendors for warranty claims and out\-of\-warranty repairs

\* Provide on\-site and remote technical support to end users

\* Escalate unresolved or complex issues to senior engineers or vendors as needed

\* Educate end users on basic troubleshooting and proper equipment handling

Requirements

\* Proven experience in desktop, laptop, and printer hardware support

\* Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills across hardware, OS, and peripheral issues

\* Familiarity with common hardware brands (Dell, HP, Lenovo, etc.) and printer brands (HP,

Canon, Epson, etc.)

\* Working knowledge of Windows OS installation, driver management, and basic networking

\* Hands\-on experience with printer configuration, network printing, and consumable

management

\* Good communication skills and customer service orientation

\* Ability to manage multiple tickets and prioritize based on urgency

Preferred Qualifications

\* Diploma/Certificate in Computer Hardware, IT, or a related field

\* Relevant hardware certification (CompTIA A\+ or equivalent) is a plus

\* Experience working with ticketing/helpdesk systems

Key Skills

Desktop Support \| Laptop Repair \| Printer Maintenance \| Hardware Troubleshooting \| OS

Installation \| Peripheral Setup \| Vendor Coordination

Pay: From ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Product Support Tech Advisor
description:
Kochi, India \| Full time \| Hybrid \| R1550648


  
Job Overview
  

Product Support Tier‑3 (T3\) individual contributor responsible for providing advanced application support, troubleshooting complex issues, and performing in‑depth debugging across multiple enterprise applications. The role requires strong hands‑on experience with IIS, Azure, SQL/PLSQL, Unix/Linux, and a solid understanding of the ITIL framework. The T3 engineer will support 40–50\+ global applications, participate in 24×7 rotational shift coverage, and work closely with Development, Infrastructure, and Service Owners to ensure system stability and timely resolution of high‑impact issues.


Essential Functions
  

Provide Tier 3 (T3\) application and integration support for high‑impact, complex, and priority incidents across regulated and non‑regulated applications in both production/non\-production environments.
  

Perform root cause analysis support for high priority incidents by collecting evidence, identifying patterns, documenting technical findings, and contributing to corrective and preventive actions.
  

Act as escalation point for Tier 2 and ensure urgent and high‑impact issues are taken up immediately with clear ownership and timely mitigation.
  

Monitor and manage script‑related and complex technical tickets on a defined cadence and ensure progress is tracked until closure.
  

Drive investigation for critical issues and deliverables, integration failures, and issues impacting multiple users or sponsor deliverables.
  

Ensure high‑priority “hypercare” items are tracked with investigation details, updates, and next actions documented consistently for visibility and faster resolution.
  

Maintain strong end‑user communication for high‑impact tickets including status updates, workarounds, and next steps while coordinating with support leads and stakeholders.
  

Actively monitor ticket queues and ensure proper triage, prioritization, assignment, and workload distribution across the shift team to avoid delays and stale tickets.
  

Acknowledge and manage escalation emails and ensure the email loop is closed with clear resolution confirmation and documented evidence.
  

Open and lead bridge calls immediately for major incidents and coordinate real‑time troubleshooting with SMEs, engineering, and dependent teams.
  

Participate in ongoing bridges and internal triage calls and ensure all required applications, dashboards, and documentation are readily available for effective incident resolution.
  

Coordinate with engineering, DBA, cloud/infra, and vendor teams to drive root cause isolation, corrective actions, and permanent fixes for recurring and systemic issues.
  

Perform deep technical troubleshooting using logs, application diagnostics, database checks, integration traces, and environment validation within authorized access boundaries.
  

Provide technical direction and guidance to Tier 2 on troubleshooting approach, data to collect, and interim workarounds to reduce business disruption.
  

Support problem management by contributing to RCA for critical incidents, documenting detailed technical findings, and ensuring corrective and preventive actions are defined and tracked.
  

Own and execute production recovery procedures for complex failures where authorized, including resubmissions, reprocessing, controlled restarts, and validation checks for data integrity.
  

Support change and release management by reviewing planned changes impacting production, assessing operational risk, supporting deployment windows, and leading post‑release validation and hypercare.
  

Ensure shift readiness by joining handover calls, reviewing prior shift communications, understanding open incidents, and continuing investigation without loss of context.
  

Drive knowledge management by creating and updating SOPs, known error articles, and troubleshooting playbooks for complex issues and repeated patterns.
  

Identify opportunities for monitoring enhancement and automation for repetitive operational tasks and coordinate implementation with relevant teams.
  

Provide operational leadership during shift by ensuring compliance to ticket updates, email management, and process adherence across the team.
  

Work in 24x7 rotational shifts including weekends and provide global coverage as per shift roster and business needs.
  

Demonstrate strong ownership, prioritization, and ability to manage multiple concurrent tickets while maintaining SLA and quality standards.


Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent, or a minimum of 8\-14 years of relevant experience in similar field.
* Experience working on Product/Application support area with rotational shift experience
* Ready to work in 24X7 shifts (Rotational Shifts including Night Shift and Weekends)
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong analytics and problem\-solving Strong problem\-solving skills.
  

  

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  

* Solid technical background and experience
* Possesses fine\-tuned analytical skills and/or programming experience
* Strong PC\-based troubleshooting skills
* Possesses solid written and verbal skills
* Azure, AWS, IIS, Oracle,.NET, Unix, SQL, Windows Server
* Good verse with scripting, automation and AI.
* Understanding of ITIL framework such as Incident Management, Problem Management and Change Managemen process
  

Pref
  

* Working knowledge of software development processes and methodologies Req
* Knowledge of the clinical trial / pharmaceutical domain Pref
* Powerful work ethic with a focus on customer satisfaction Intermediate
* Strong customer facing and presentation skills Intermediate
* Process documentation skills Intermediate
* Validation documentation and execution skills

Intermediate
  

* Technical troubleshooting and documentation skills Intermediate

title: System Engineer (L2)
description:

B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science/ Information Technology / BCA / MCA
  
  

**Experience :**  

2\+ Years
  
  

**Skills :**  

* SQL \& Database Operations
* Application Troubleshooting
* Root Cause Analysis
* Data Issue Resolution
* Debugging \& Problem Solving
* JavaScript – Basic
* jQuery – Basic
* HTML \& CSS – Basic
* ERP / CRM Systems
* Ticketing Tools
* Customer Communication
* Technical Documentation
* Business/Domain Understanding
* Team Collaboration


**Industry:**  

IT / Software / ERP / CRM
  
  

**Job Description:**  

The System Engineer Functional (L2\) role is a critical escalation point for issue analysis and resolution, focusing on deeper technical investigation, data integrity, and collaboration with development teams. This position requires strong SQL skills, product knowledge, technical knowledge, and the ability to work closely with both customers and coordination with L1 Support, L3 Development, IT, Product, and Support teams.
  
  

**Responsiblity:**  

* Analyze issues escalated by System Engineer – Functional (L1\) and identify the root cause.
* Investigate application and database\-level issues in detail.
* Resolve data\-related issues efficiently while maintaining data integrity.
* Prepare SQL queries for data modifications or deletions and coordinate with the Support Lead for review and execution.
* Communicate with customers when additional information or clarification is required.
* Coordinate with the IT team to obtain customer database backups for analysis and testing.
* Replicate customer issues using backup companies/environments.
* Validate SQL queries and resolution steps before live implementation.
* Escalate development\-related bugs to Software Engineers (L3\) with detailed observations.
* Collaborate with Product Lead (L4\) and Support Lead on recurring product issues.
* Support long\-term solutions to improve product stability.
* Organize departmental/vertical meetings and prepare concise meeting reports.
* Maintain proper documentation of investigations, resolutions, and technical findings.


**Requirements:**  

* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in technical/application support or a related role.
* Strong SQL and database troubleshooting skills.
* Good understanding of application and database\-level issue analysis.
* Basic knowledge of JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, and CSS.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving abilities.
* Good business/domain understanding.
* Familiarity with CRM/ERP systems and ticketing tools.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.


**Perference :**  

Candidates with experience in ERP/CRM application support, L2 technical support, SQL\-based troubleshooting, issue replication, and coordination with development teams are preferred.
  
  

**Location :**  

Aluva, Kerala
  
  

**Salary :**  

Best in Industry
